the author's own proof environment immediately following the lemma: Quasi-finiteness propagates from the finite source-fibre of u to every object u_j isomorphic to u and to every arrow between them: the source fibre points are isolated in the fibre of R over p, the flat locally finitely presented target map of fibres is open, and the scheme-theoretic source fibres are finite over their residue fields by the two-fibres lemma applied within the orbit. The technical etale splitting lemma for quasi-finite parts, applied to the two pairs of structure morphisms with the orbit point sets, produces the etale neighbourhood with residue field identification and the open and closed decompositions of the base changes into finite pieces U' and R' plus complements, giving conclusions (a) through (d) and the fibre level versions of (e) and (f). Zariski shrinking by removing closed images of the open and closed complements upgrades (e) and (f) to global inclusions, also for the unit and inverse maps, and the groupoid axioms of the restricted structure are inherited from the full base change, giving (g). (source lines 2447-2561)
